faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIIT Kalyani JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIIT Kalyani is 23 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under the TTDF/TCoE project at the Indian Institute of Information Technology Kalyani.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will receive a monthly consolidated salary of ₹ 37,000 plus HRA as per the project norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is the application process online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates are required to send a hard copy of their application via post and a soft copy via email to the specified addresses.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's degree in Engineering, Technology, or Science with at least 60% marks, or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology with 70% marks and a valid GATE/NET qualification.

faq.question: Q6. Where should I send the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: The hard copy should be sent to: Registrar, Indian Institute of Information Technology Kalyani, IIIT/A-23, WARD NO. 18, KALYANI, NADIA-741235, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment at IIIT Kalyani.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two stages: shortlisting of candidates based on their eligibility and academic credentials, followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates with a Bachelor's degree apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology are eligible to apply, provided they have a minimum CGPA of 7.5 or 70% marks and possess a valid GATE or NET score.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position. Candidates are advised to check the official document for any updates.
